title: AEGIS control plane gateway registration, version 1
description: Announces one gateway deployment to a control plane. Carries no prompt content, no response content, and no audit event. The organization is not named here: it is determined by the bearer token presented with the request.

name.description: Operator-chosen label distinguishing this deployment within its organization. Never derived from a governed request. Registration is idempotent on this value.

gateway_version.description: Build version of the registering gateway.
